answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because wander only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, kernel is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any basalt approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
